name: Scout
description: Cited research that re-checks every quote and keeps a library of findings
about: Ask Scout a question and it checks its own library before searching the web, X, Reddit, GitHub and YouTube. Every quote is re-opened and checked for wording, author and date before the answer ships. Claims are tagged confirmed, likely or speculative, and saved for next time.
features: Reuse past findings before searching again
Re-verify every quote, author and date
Tag each claim confirmed, likely or speculative
examplePrompt: Deep research: how are developers reacting to Cursor Projects on X and Reddit, and what would change that picture?
